page.layout: One printed page of text in one column, with no headings. The margins hold only small reference marks, not printed notes. Running head at top; page number at top right.

p.i: nam. Nam multiforma mulierum sedu-li funt, & amor ex ea in modum ignis exardescit. Apud mulierem maritatam ne sedeas omnino, nec inter ulnas eius recumbas, neue committas cum ea com-potandi gratia symbolum, ut ne forte ad eam inclinet animus tuus, & affectu tuo prolabaris in pernitiem:

main_text.p: 1 Docet Iefus Syracides his sententijs primum, quomodo vir se gerere debeat erga uxorem: dein quomodo erga alias mulieres, siue fint meretrices, siue virgines, siue maritatæ. Estque hæc doctrina nostris temporibus valde utilis & necessaria. Prædixit enim Christus, Luc.17. quod sic erit in diebus filij hominis (.i. postremis, qui nunc sunt) sicut accidit in diebus Noe: nam edebant, bibebant, uxores ducebant, &c. Item videntes filij Dei (ut Moses testatur Genesis 6.) filias hominum, quod essent pulchræ, acceperunt sibi uxores ex omnibus quas elegerant.

2 Dicit autem Sapiens: Ne zeles mulierem sinus tui) i.amor uxoris non sit nimius: in sinu tuo quiescentem non ames amore zelotypo, ut [?]uiter timeas ab ipsa te minus amari, amati[?] autem & ab alijs, propter quod & eam amar[?] etius quàm par fit, folicitè custodi-as: non sis nimium suspiciosus de castitate uxoris propriæ. Ratio: ne ostendat super te ma-

page.notes: Printed text is set in roman with italic epigraph at top. Long s is transcribed as plain s; u/v and i/j normalised. Doubtful readings: "uiter" and "amati" in the second paragraph are hard to read in the scan; "etius" and "amar" are also uncertain. "pernitiem" as printed (probably perditionem in the Vulgate, but copied as shown). "Estque" read from a worn long-s form. Margin has small asterisk-like reference marks beside the lines "videntes" and "quod", with no matching printed note text, so none is transcribed. The ")" after "sinus tui" and the colon after "pernitiem" are as printed. The paragraph ends mid-word "ma-" and continues onto the next page.
